CHAPTER 6 · ITEM 06 / 12

Price ceilings and floors

Short-run versus long-run shortage短長期短缺

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Compare short- and long-run shortages when supply and demand become more elastic, as in rent control.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

租金上限固定時，長期供給更能收縮，需求更能增加，短缺因而可能比短期更大。比較時要固定其他條件及原均衡。

At a fixed rent ceiling, more elastic long-run supply can reduce housing offered more, while more elastic demand raises desired quantity more. Together these can enlarge the shortage relative to the short run.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：Short run Qd=110, Qs=90 gives shortage 20; long run Qd=130, Qs=70 gives shortage 60. 長期調整令短缺擴大。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

With the same binding ceiling and more responsive supply and demand, shortage generally? 同上限、供需更有彈性？
